dependencies: PB-A00 (parent amendments; must be CLOSED before any writer act)

postgres_requirements.rationale: A real PostgreSQL probe is MANDATORY for every DB, RLS, ACL, state-machine and atomicity claim of this batch, on the DISPOSABLE harness only (scripts/db-audit-disposable.ts / tests/postgres/disposable-db.ts, gated on UELLIX_PG_TESTS=1), never staging, production or the canonical local stack. Both harness paths are legitimately UNKNOWN because no implementing act exists yet; naming them would be a fabricated fact. Static reading is insufficient because the load-bearing properties - policy-pair composition, zero-member capability roles, column-scoped grants, append-only triggers, Shape M rollback, advisory-lock serialization and the platform-bit catalogue precondition - are only observable by executing against a real catalogue. protected_authority is null because this manifest is frozen by a docs-only lane; each protected act (PB-A01..PB-A06) names its own grant when allocated.

sentinels.purpose: A synthetic project/evidence/report marker planted in a fixture Organization; PB-N-5 asserts it never appears in any Pilot verb result, preview, audit row or log line.

A live COMMERCIAL_EXCEPTION grant planted by the disposable-harness owner under a BOOTSTRAP account, and under an ACTIVE_WITHOUT_STRIPE account past its review_horizon; PB-N-12 asserts the gate refuses it.
A forged 'aal2' value supplied through every client-controlled channel (header, form field, query parameter, cookie, argument); PB-N-3 asserts it never reaches request.jwt.claims.
A test-only basis entry with pro_bono true and a known sha256; PB-N-17 mutates one hex digit and asserts refusal.

positive_controls.description: PB-A00. Each parent amendment materialized by PB-A00 is deep-equal in substance to PILOT_BILLING_EXECUTION_AUTHORITY SECTION_8 (MC-P1..MC-P6), names its base in amends, and its parent-level and node-level ACL maps (MC-P5) are deep-equal to each other.

PB-A01/PB-A02/PB-A04. After CE-4 every pre-existing Organization is governed by exactly one CommercialAccount with an opening history row (B3), commercial_status is a member of the six-state set with DEFAULT BOOTSTRAP, and every seed grant follows B4 exactly. Real PostgreSQL.

PB-A06 V-GOVERN. A platform principal at AAL2 gives an ungoverned Organization one new CommercialAccount in BOOTSTRAP, sets organizations.commercial_account_id from NULL and appends the opening history row in ONE transaction, writing zero entitlement_grants rows and one commercial.state.entered audit row. Real PostgreSQL.

PB-A06 V-ACTIVATE (derives parent P-14). From BOOTSTRAP with no Stripe subscription, activation enters ACTIVE_WITHOUT_STRIPE, inserts one arrangement row, opens one COMMERCIAL_EXCEPTION grant per governed Organization with the explicit capacity, writes the projection, and writes commercial.state.entered, commercial.manual_activation and entitlement.grant.opened rows carrying non-NULL actor, reason, before_json, after_json with authorization_reference, basis snapshot, package_ref, review_horizon and assurance evidence - all in ONE transaction. Real PostgreSQL.

PB-A07. With ACTIVE_WITHOUT_STRIPE and a live COMMERCIAL_EXCEPTION grant (CAPPED and UNMETERED cases), a Stella ticket is issued, bound and completed through issueOperationTicket with no Stripe environment variable set and every Stripe SDK entry point stubbed to throw.

PB-A05/PB-A07. CAPPED N: exactly N binds succeed in one UTC month for that Organization, the N+1th is refused quota_exceeded at L2 while L3 passes, and a sibling Organization under the same CommercialAccount is unaffected (no pooled quota). Real PostgreSQL.
PB-A05. UNMETERED projects stella_monthly_quota NULL and L2 imposes no cap; BLOCKED projects 0.

PB-A06 V-ADJUST. Changing capacity or package closes the live grant (effective_to set once) and inserts its replacement in one transaction; the full row history remains reconstructible and the projection follows. Real PostgreSQL.

PB-A06 V-RENEW. Before the horizon, renewal closes the live arrangement row with closure_cause renewed and inserts its successor with a new authorization_reference and horizon; grants are untouched; one commercial.manual_activation.renewed row.

PB-A06 V-DEACTIVATE. ACTIVE_WITHOUT_STRIPE -> BOOTSTRAP closes every live COMMERCIAL_EXCEPTION grant of the governed Organizations and the arrangement row, projects 0, and audits - in ONE transaction (derives parent P-20's ACTIVE_WITHOUT_STRIPE -> BOOTSTRAP pair). Real PostgreSQL.

PB-A06/PB-A07. After deactivation, and in a SUSPENDED fixture, members keep sign-in, membership, role, organizations.status and READ access to their historical evidence and reports (derives parent P-09).
PB-A06. Re-activation after deactivation uses a NEW authorization_reference and opens NEW grant and arrangement rows; every previously closed row keeps its original effective_to.

PB-A03/PB-A06 V-LAPSE. Once transaction_timestamp() >= review_horizon, the gate refuses before lapse runs; V-LAPSE then moves the account to BOOTSTRAP with actor_user_id NULL and reason manual_activation_lapsed, the executor recorded in after_json. Real PostgreSQL with a controlled clock.
PB-A06 V-INSPECT. A platform principal at AAL2, holding no membership in the target Organization, reads exactly the closed projection of SECTION_10 without app.organization_id being set.
PB-A06 V-PREVIEW. For activate, adjust, renew, deactivate and lapse, the preview returns a before/after diff identical to the one the subsequent committed verb records.

PB-A06. A Pro Bono activation using a test-only basis entry with pro_bono true snapshots basis_key, version and policy digest onto the arrangement row and carries the explicitly chosen capacity on a COMMERCIAL_EXCEPTION grant.
PB-A06. Replaying any write verb with the same authorization_reference and identical inputs returns the original outcome and writes zero rows (state, arrangement, grants, projection, audit).

PB-A08 PILOT GOLDEN JOURNEY. signup -> B0 -> L0 -> found Organization -> L1 accepted by organization_admin -> Stella refused entitlement_absent -> platform V-GOVERN -> V-PREVIEW -> V-ACTIVATE (CAPPED N) -> Stella issued, bound, charged -> V-ADJUST -> V-RENEW -> V-DEACTIVATE -> Stella refused entitlement_blocked with membership intact -> V-ACTIVATE again -> horizon passes -> refused -> V-LAPSE. Executed AS uellix_app through the runtime identity on the disposable substrate with no Stripe configuration, no SQL step and no legacy-column write outside the CE-5 writer.
PB-A06/PB-A07. For an Organization whose L1 is current, an activated capability is usable end to end (the positive half of PB-N-8).

PB-A07. The ticket boundary returns three distinct refusal vocabularies: L1 rate limit, L3 entitlement_absent / entitlement_blocked / entitlement_unavailable, L2 no_quota / quota_exceeded; no two layers share a code (derives parent SC-7 obligation).

negative_controls.description: PB-A06. Every Pilot verb, V-INSPECT and V-PREVIEW included, is REFUSED for: anon; an authenticated non-platform subject; an organization_admin of the target Organization; a subject whose organization_members.role is 'super_admin' but whose users.is_super_admin is false; and uellix_app with no claims. Enumerated, not sampled. Real PostgreSQL.

PB-A06. A platform principal with aal1 is refused AAL_ABSENT and with a missing or malformed aal claim is refused AAL_UNDETERMINABLE, distinguishably, for every verb. Real PostgreSQL through the definers, not only the route.
PB-A06. SENTINEL_CLIENT_AAL supplied through every client-controlled channel never reaches request.jwt.claims; only the aal of the server-verified token does.

PB-A06. Every Pilot verb inserts, updates and deletes ZERO organization_members rows (counted before and after) and never sets app.organization_id; the acting platform principal gains no membership and no role.

PB-A06. SENTINEL_TENANT_CONTENT never appears in any verb result, preview, audit row or log; the result column set of V-INSPECT equals the frozen closed projection; a static census of the Pilot definers finds no reference to a tenant-content relation or to a legal-acceptance relation.
PB-A06. NULL, empty and whitespace-only reason is refused by every write verb and by V-PREVIEW, and by the D-9 non-blank CHECK on direct insertion by the owning role.

PB-A06 SELF-GRANT. (a) With a fixture granting authenticated (and separately uellix_app) UPDATE on users.is_super_admin, every Pilot verb refuses PLATFORM_AUTHORITY_SELF_GRANTABLE; (b) no Pilot verb writes users, organization_members or any role value; (c) no verb changes the platform principal set. Real PostgreSQL.

PB-A06/PB-A07 LEGAL. With L1 absent, superseded by a reaccept_required version, or pre-effective, an Organization under ACTIVE_WITHOUT_STRIPE with a live grant is refused before L3 on both issuance surfaces; ACTIVE_WITHOUT_STRIPE never makes deriveOrganizationAcceptanceCurrent true; no Pilot verb reads, writes or returns any acceptance relation (static and runtime).

PB-A00/PB-A03/PB-A06. ACTIVE_WITHOUT_STRIPE is reachable only by V-ACTIVATE: a direct UPDATE of commercial_status by uellix_app, authenticated or the Pilot role outside the state verb is refused; the state verb refuses entry without person actor, reason, authorization_reference and review_horizon; activation is refused from ACTIVE_STRIPE, PAST_DUE, SUSPENDED, ACTIVE_WITHOUT_STRIPE and CLOSED (derives parent N-09).
PB-A07. Missing entitlement is refused entitlement_absent: an ungoverned new Organization with no grant, and an ACTIVE_WITHOUT_STRIPE Organization whose grant effective_from is in the future.
PB-A07. A BLOCKED grant is refused entitlement_blocked and NO ticket row is minted.

PB-A03/PB-A07 WITHDRAWAL FAILS CLOSED. Capability is refused after V-DEACTIVATE; and, with SENTINEL_STALE_COMMERCIAL_GRANT still live, under BOOTSTRAP (G-1), under ACTIVE_WITHOUT_STRIPE past review_horizon or without a live arrangement (G-2), and under SUSPENDED and CLOSED fixtures. Real PostgreSQL.
PB-A06. Deactivation, lapse and every other Pilot verb write ZERO rows of organizations.status, organization_members, evidence or reports (derives parent N-07; PI-1).

PB-A04/PB-A06/PB-A07 CROSS-ORG. CE-4 seeds strictly 1:1 and never groups Organizations under one account by inference, alters no tenant row other than the new FK, and creates no membership (BACKFILL prohibitions). Activation of account A writes no grant for any Organization outside A's governed set; a member of Organization B evaluating Organization A is refused U0113, never answered empty and never answered with B's entitlement (SEC-6); a shared CommercialAccount widens no tenant visibility (SEC-7).

PB-A05/PB-A06. No Pilot path issues an UPDATE of any entitlement_grants column other than the single effective_to close; the CE-3 append-only trigger refuses a limit_value UPDATE; row counts are monotone across every verb.

PB-A06. A write whose audit insert fails, or would lack actor (for a person-caused verb), reason, before_json, after_json or the commercial/policy reference, rolls the whole transaction back; there is no unaudited Pilot mutation.

PB-A06. A Pro Bono (or any) activation is refused for an unknown basis_key, an unknown version, an empty catalogue, or a digest differing from SENTINEL_PRO_BONO_DIGEST by one hex digit; production catalogue loading refuses test-only entries.

PB-A06. Pro Bono never implies unlimited: an activation without an explicit limit kind is refused; UNMETERED is refused unless the entry admits it; CAPPED above max_capped_value is refused; no code path supplies UNMETERED as a default.

PB-A06 SHAPE M. Injected failure at the state verb, the arrangement write, the CE-5 writer, the projection and the audit insert, for activate, adjust, renew, deactivate and lapse, leaves commercial_status, arrangement rows, grants, projection and audit exactly as before; no committed state has commercial_status and live grants disagreeing. Real PostgreSQL.

PB-A01/PB-A02/PB-A05/PB-A06 DIRECT BYPASS. uellix_app, uellix_writer, authenticated and anon are refused INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE on commercial_accounts, entitlement_grants, the history relation and D-9; the history relation refuses DELETE and any UPDATE of a closed row, including by its owning role (append-only guard); the Pilot definers live in a schema absent from supabase/config.toml api schemas and are not EXECUTE-able by authenticated or anon; no routine Pilot step in the Golden journey uses SQL or a legacy-column write.

Capability catalogue closed world: the TypeScript catalogue and the SQL literal both carry exactly stella.grounded_query; every Pilot verb refuses any other key; a static census finds no second capability key.

PB-A06/PB-A07/PB-A08 NO STRIPE. The Pilot Golden journey completes with every Stripe SDK entry point stubbed to throw and records zero Stripe calls. No Pilot module imports lib/stripe/** or the Stripe SDK; app/api/webhooks/stripe/route.ts WEBHOOK_DATABASE_IDENTITY_AVAILABLE remains false; no Pilot path reads or writes any stripe_* column or stripe_webhook_events; the Pilot diff touches none of the anti_pull_in_rule paths; STRIPE_QUOTAS.free is unreachable from every Pilot write path.

PB-A05. Exactly one writer of organizations.stella_monthly_quota and stella_plan_label exists after CE-5 (catalogue privileges plus exhaustive static census including db/prepared/**); the legacy admin quota write path is removed or repointed and is never a second writer.
PB-A06. CAPPED 0 and negative or non-integer N are refused at the Pilot input; UNMETERED and BLOCKED with a non-NULL limit_value are refused.

PB-A06. V-ACTIVATE is refused when the account governs ZERO Organizations, when the capacity map does not equal the governed set exactly, when a live PLAN grant exists for a governed Organization, and when a reused authorization_reference carries different inputs.
PB-A06. V-ADJUST and V-RENEW are refused at or after review_horizon; the only lawful path is V-LAPSE then V-ACTIVATE.

PB-A07 GATE LOCUS. The evaluator consumer census stays closed-world with EXACTLY ONE runtime consumer (db/stella/operation-tickets.ts); no call from the request principal, selected-organization carrier, session helpers, Measure, Portfolio, Evaluate, middleware, app/api/** or db/identity-context.ts; issueOperationTicket is the only caller of the SQL mint.
PB-A06. V-PREVIEW writes zero rows to every relation, for every previewed verb, including when the previewed verb would be refused.

PB-A06 S5P. Every Pilot surface executes with organizationId NULL, never reads the selected-organization carrier and never calls requireOrganizationAccess or withOrganizationDatabaseContext; and with the '!check.is_super_admin' conjunct at db/identity-context.ts:217 removed in a test build, every Pilot control still passes (no dependence on the exemption).

PB-A06. The Pilot plane exposes no PA-2, PA-3, PA-6-beyond-manual-basis or closure verb; no Pilot verb opens a grant of source PLAN, PLATFORM_ADMIN or BOOTSTRAP_DEFAULT; V-GOVERN refuses an Organization whose commercial_account_id is already non-NULL.

mutation_controls.description: Guarantee: AAL2 is enforced at the definer. Mutation: remove the aal check from one Pilot definer. Must turn PB-N-2 RED for that verb.
Guarantee: aal is server-derived. Mutation: read aal from a request header. Must turn PB-N-3 RED.
Guarantee: activation is atomic. Mutation: open the grant in a second transaction after the state commit. Must turn PB-N-19 RED.
Guarantee: deactivation is atomic. Mutation: commit BOOTSTRAP before closing COMMERCIAL_EXCEPTION grants. Must turn PB-N-19 RED and, with G-1 also removed, PB-N-12 RED.
Guarantee: G-1. Mutation: restore BOOTSTRAP pass-through for COMMERCIAL_EXCEPTION. Must turn PB-N-12 RED against SENTINEL_STALE_COMMERCIAL_GRANT under BOOTSTRAP.
Guarantee: G-2. Mutation: drop the review_horizon comparison. Must turn PB-N-12 RED for the lapsed-horizon case and PB-P-13's pre-lapse refusal RED.
Guarantee: non-blank reason. Mutation: accept an empty reason. Must turn PB-N-6 RED.
Guarantee: L1 precedes L3. Mutation: evaluate L3 before the L1 gate on one issuance surface. Must turn PB-N-8 RED.
Guarantee: Pro Bono is never implicitly unlimited. Mutation: default a Pro Bono activation's limit kind to UNMETERED. Must turn PB-N-18 RED.
Guarantee: platform predicate, not tenant role. Mutation: admit organization_members.role = 'super_admin'. Must turn PB-N-1 RED.
Guarantee: self-grant refusal. Mutation: remove the platform-bit integrity precondition. Must turn PB-N-7(a) RED.
Guarantee: single gate locus. Mutation: call the evaluator from requireOrganizationAccess or add a second runtime consumer. Must turn PB-N-27 RED.
Guarantee: adjustment preserves history. Mutation: implement V-ADJUST as an in-place limit_value UPDATE. Must turn PB-N-15 RED (trigger refusal asserted) and PB-P-8 RED.
Guarantee: closed capability catalogue. Mutation: add a second key to the TypeScript catalogue only. Must turn PB-N-21 RED.
Guarantee: no Stripe on the Pilot path. Mutation: import lib/stripe/client.ts into a Pilot module. Must turn PB-N-22 RED.
Guarantee: platform context never enters the tenant. Mutation: set app.organization_id, or insert a membership, inside a Pilot verb. Must turn PB-N-4 RED and PB-N-29 RED.
Guarantee: a set-based precondition asserts its set is non-empty. Mutation: remove the non-empty governed-Organization check. Must turn PB-N-25 RED.

Guarantee: the mutation battery can fail. Mutation: a designated real survivor (a mutation no control is expected to catch, declared in advance) is run first; the battery must report it as SURVIVED, proving the battery is not self-fulfilling before any other mutation result is accepted.
